description: Stormwater_Features is a dataset listed in City of Gainesville open data portal (data.cityofgainesville.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Gainesville. For NPDES Stormwater sewer system enhanced mapping project. Contains a GIS polygon feature class of stormwater basins in Gainesville, FL as a result of the NPDES stormwater system mapping project. This feature does not participate in the GIS network, and is for cartographic purposes only. Coverage: Gainesville, Florida. The portal files it under the category Geospatial (Maps). Its tags are pond, alachua, basin, depression, fl. The table has 29 columns. Attribution on the portal: Public Works. The portal shows 2014-09-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofgainesville-org-portal.
